about: Mixed-model reference inputs (issue #79), written by scripts/reference/mixed_model_inputs.mjs from tests/reference/mixedModelCases.ts. Synthetic data. Research use only.

cases.name: random_slope_no_factors
cases.description: Random intercept and slope per patient, no covariates; 18 patients, quarterly medians.
cases.dataRCode:
mm_data <- data.frame(
      patient_id = factor(mm_patient_id),
      value = as.numeric(mm_value),
      time_since_baseline = as.numeric(mm_time),
      baseline_age_centered = as.numeric(mm_baseline_age_centered)
    )
cases.modelCall: lme4::lmer(value ~ time_since_baseline + (1 + time_since_baseline | patient_id), data = mm_data, REML = TRUE, na.action = na.fail)

cases.name: categorical_and_numeric_factor
cases.description: Random intercept and slope; genotype (categorical, level and slope, reference A) and dose (numeric, level); 24 patients.
cases.formula: value ~ time_since_baseline + factor_0_ + time_since_baseline:factor_0_ + factor_1_ + (1 + time_since_baseline | patient_id)
cases.dataRCode:
mm_data <- data.frame(
      patient_id = factor(mm_patient_id),
      value = as.numeric(mm_value),
      time_since_baseline = as.numeric(mm_time),
      baseline_age_centered = as.numeric(mm_baseline_age_centered)
    )
    mm_levels <- c("A", sort(setdiff(unique(mm_factor_0_), "A"), method = "radix"))
      mm_data$factor_0_ <- factor(mm_factor_0_, levels = mm_levels)
      contrasts(mm_data$factor_0_) <- contr.treatment(mm_levels, base = 1)
mm_data$factor_1_ <- as.numeric(mm_factor_1_)
cases.modelCall: lme4::lmer(value ~ time_since_baseline + factor_0_ + time_since_baseline:factor_0_ + factor_1_ + (1 + time_since_baseline | patient_id), data = mm_data, REML = TRUE, na.action = na.fail)

cases.name: random_intercept_baseline_age
cases.description: Random intercept only, baseline age (centred) as covariate through the legacy covariates field; 15 patients.
cases.dataRCode:
mm_data <- data.frame(
      patient_id = factor(mm_patient_id),
      value = as.numeric(mm_value),
      time_since_baseline = as.numeric(mm_time),
      baseline_age_centered = as.numeric(mm_baseline_age_centered)
    )
    mm_data$baseline_age_centered <- as.numeric(mm_baseline_age_centered)
cases.modelCall: lme4::lmer(value ~ time_since_baseline + baseline_age_centered + (1 | patient_id), data = mm_data, REML = TRUE, na.action = na.fail)
